title: feat(spec): an action's confirm and param dialogs can name their dismiss button — `cancelText`
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Ut7hw65Gi64QMYVAVzsgLi)_
Part of #28519

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` (the action key list teaches `submitText` beside `confirmText`) and `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` (the `_actions.{action_name}` key row). Both are governed (Tier H), so they ride a separate PR rather than this one; neither turns false here, they only lack the new key.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:动作(action)新增可选键 `cancelText`,给动作弹出的确认框或参数框的「取消」按钮起名字；可写纯字符串或多语言映射，翻译路径 `objects.对象._actions.动作.cancelText`;空字符串、或在不弹框的动作上写它，解析时直接拒收。
- 为什么改:动词本身就是「取消……」的动作(如邀请列表的「Cancel Invitation」)弹确认框时，两个按钮是「Cancel」和「Cancel Invitation」,管理员分不清哪个是保留邀请。这次先落 spec 半边，控制台画按钮、`sys_invitation` 声明「Keep invitation」留给后续卡(与 `submitText` 当初的拆法相同)。
- 风险与回滚:纯放宽，不写这个键的动作解析结果完全不变；目前没有界面读它，liveness 标 `planned` 并让 `os validate` 提醒作者「按钮还显示 Cancel」。回滚即撤掉本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`(`actionCancelText` 与新加的第三条 refine:没有 `confirmText` 也没有非空 `params` 时拒收);`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` 的 `translateAction` 叠加条件;`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts` 的 `checkActionCancelText`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/action-cancel-text.test.ts`,应看到 20 条全过。
- 需要你做的:确认新公开键名 `cancelText`(席位已在项目里问你);其余无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`ActionSchema.cancelText`** (`@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/spec/ui`): an optional `I18nLabel`, the label of the dismiss button on the dialog an action opens before it runs, in place of the console's default "Cancel". Two dialogs carry that button and an action opens at most one: the confirm dialog of a param-less action that declares `confirmText`, and the param dialog of an action with a non-empty `params` (beside that dialog's `submitText`).
  - A blank string (`''` or whitespace only) is refused at parse, through `NON_BLANK_STRING`, so the published JSON Schema carries the rule too.
  - A new refinement refuses the key on an action that declares neither `confirmText` nor a non-empty `params`: no dialog opens, so the label would parse clean and never show (ADR-0078). It mirrors `submitText`'s no-`params` refusal, widened to the two hosts this button has.
  - `cancelLabel` is an alias that renames to `cancelText`, on the action and in a translation bundle. It is the spelling of the same button on the console's `form` and `alert-dialog` renderers, the `*Label` twin of `submitLabel`.
  - `InlineActionSchema` does not pick the key, as it does not pick `submitText`: no inline host forwards either.
- **Translation slot.** `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION.cancelText` and `globalActions.ACTION.cancelText` (`translation.zod.ts`). `translateAction` overlays it for an action that opens either dialog, judged on the AUTHORED `confirmText` / `params`, and never gives a button to an action that opens none.
- **Lint.** `validateTranslationReferences` reports a `cancelText` translation under an action that declares neither `confirmText` nor `params` as `translation-target-unknown` at `error` (`checkActionCancelText`), at both addresses.
- **Ledgers.** `liveness/action.json` gains a `planned` row with `authorWarn` (nothing draws the key yet), and `state-counts/action.md` is regenerated (planned 2 → 3). The metadata-form reconciliation ledger gains an `omit` row (no Studio control is offered until the console draws the key). `authorable-surface/ui.json` lists `ui/Action:cancelText`. `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS` in `@object-ui/core` lists it.
- **Docs.** A `cancelText` section in `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` beside `submitText`'s, the interface listing line, and the `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` action row. The `content/docs/references/**` pages are regenerated.
- The `submitText` docblock now names `actionCancelText` as its pair. `object-form`'s own `submitText` / `cancelText` describes in `component.zod.ts` are left as they are: `submitText`'s precedent added no back-reference there either.

### Forced test edits

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts`: the served `action` key count 51 → 52, and the sample names `cancelText`.
- `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`: the new `omit` row for `cancelText` (a schema key the action form does not offer must be ledgered).
- `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.test.ts`: the action-entry coverage table classifies every key the translation shape declares, so `cancelText` gets a `reference-checked` row (host `noPreRunDialog`), and the real-instance leg carries it.
- `ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionKeys.ts`: the `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS` inventory, pinned against the spec's declared keys by `actionKeys.pin.test.ts`.

## Why

#28519: on Setup → Invitations, the row menu's **Cancel Invitation** opens a confirm whose two buttons read **Cancel** and **Cancel Invitation**. `ActionSchema` has the param dialog's submit label (`submitText`) but no key for the dismiss button. This PR is the spec half (Wanted 1). Wanted 2 (the console's `ActionConfirmDialog` / `ActionParamDialog` draw it) and Wanted 3 (`sys_invitation.cancel_invitation` declares `cancelText: 'Keep invitation'` with its translations) are the ui / platform-objects half, split the way `submitText` was split.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/ui/action-cancel-text.test.ts` (new, 20 tests): both I18nLabel forms on both host dialogs, optional, the non-I18nLabel shapes `label` refuses, the blank refusal on both hosts, the no-dialog refusal (no `params` and `params: []`, string and locale map) with its control, the `cancelLabel` rename, not on `InlineActionSchema`, the translation slot at both addresses with the bundle alias, and `translateAction` on the confirm host, the param host, `globalActions`, the locale fallback, an action that authors none, and an action that opens no dialog.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.test.ts`: a `cancelText` describe (errors at both addresses under an action that opens no dialog; the controls: accepted under a confirm host and under a param host), plus the coverage rows above.

## Acceptance notes

- **Implementation choice, raised for the seat:** the no-dialog refusal is not in the card's Wanted 1 text. It is the `submitText` precedent's second rule carried over, because without it `cancelText` on a click-to-run action would parse clean and never show. It judges `confirmText != null` (the declaration), not the console's truthiness test: a blank `confirmText` already fails `os validate`, `compile` and the publish gate, so the refusal does not add a second message for it.
- **Default stays the console's.** Absent, both dialogs keep their own "Cancel" (`actionConfirm.cancel` / `actionDialog.cancel`). The console's confirm dialog already draws `options.cancelText` over its default; what it lacks is the runner handing the action's key to it (`ActionRunner.confirmOptions` passes `title` / `confirmText` / `destructive` only, and `ActionDef` does not declare the key). That is the follow-up's first file.
- **Migrations checked, nothing owed:** `git grep -c "cancelLabel\|cancelText" -- packages/spec/src/migrations packages/spec/src/conversions` answers 0 files (control: `submitLabel` hits 4 files, 17 lines). `element:form`'s retired keys are six and none is a cancel label (`retired-keys/18.ui__ElementFormProps__*`), and the `translation-component-submit-label-retired` D3 entry concerns the component copy key `submitLabel` alone. `cancelText` moves no existing key, so no conversion or semantic entry is owed.
- **Stale sentence noted, not fixed here:** `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`'s `submitText` section still ends "The console does not draw it yet", which #28392 made false (the liveness row is `live`). Not this card's defect class; carrier: the console follow-up of this card, which edits the same file to flip `cancelText`'s matching sentence.

## Verification

All readings on head `6e2b3ddb` (this branch with `origin/main` `3e62a22c` merged in) unless a line says otherwise; every heavy run went through `os-verify-lock.sh`, whose `VERDICT command-exit` line is quoted.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 189 passed (189), Tests 7829 passed (7829). VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`, re-run after the `main` merge (main moved `metadata-protocol/src`): Test Files 297 passed, 4 skipped (301), Tests 22093 passed, 26 skipped. VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core test`: Test Files 228 passed (228), Tests 4226 passed, 27 skipped. VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `typecheck` for `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (spec's includes `check:test-typecheck`): all Done, VERDICT command-exit 0; `@object-ui/core` `type-check`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the eight changed `.ts` files under `packages/`: exit 0; `ui` eslint over `ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionKeys.ts`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix`: regenerated exactly `content/docs/references/**` and `liveness/state-counts/`, then re-checked both green; `check:api-surface` green against a dist that run built (no export moved).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one per changed tested behaviour; each landed on disk through ablation-replace and restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

- `action.zod.ts`, the no-dialog refinement's `data.cancelText != null` → `false`: `action-cancel-text.test.ts` 2 failed | 18 passed (the two no-dialog refusals). Restored: blob == HEAD.
- `validate-translation-references.ts`, `checkActionCancelText`'s `confirmText` guard → bare `return`: `validate-translation-references.test.ts` 2 failed | 231 passed (the `cancelText` error leg and the coverage table's reference-checked leg). Restored.
- `i18n-resolver.ts`, `const cancelText = opensDialog` → `true`: `action-cancel-text.test.ts` 1 failed | 19 passed ("gives no button to an action that opens no dialog"). Restored.
- Reverse verification of the cross-package pin: `'cancelText'` deleted from `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS` → `actionKeys.pin.test.ts` 1 failed | 18 passed, `missing: ['cancelText']`, so the pin reads the rebuilt spec. Restored.

</details>

- All 109 exit 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 (its pinned fixture commit is outside the shallow clone); after `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876…` it reports 48 cases pass, exit 0.

- `check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main --event` (this body, offline): exit 0, `@objectstack/spec: minor` for `Clause-②: yes (widening)` + `Metadata-protocol: added`.
- Local-only families: `check:skill-frame-freshness` exit 0; `check:dev-prereqs` exit 1 as a box precondition (34 `ui/` workspace dists not built in this container; the `packages/**` build is 78/78 tasks), not a reading about this diff.
